claim: A discount can only be applied by the owner of the order; any other user must receive 403.
Calling POST /orders/{id}/discount without the X-User-Id header must return 422, not 500.
Calling POST /orders/{id}/discount with an unknown X-User-Id must return 401.
A 403 response from POST /orders/{id}/discount must not expose the order total or other user data.
POST /orders/{id}/discount with a null-byte or special-character X-User-Id must not return 500.
